title.narrative: ROAP/VIE03/Promoting Youth and Community Innovation for City Sustainable Development

description.narrative: Context: Vietnam's socio-economic development strategy focuses on institutional reform, improvements to science / human resources, and infrastructure development. Key challenges are a) funding dependency from central government b) lack of capacity in leveraging existing social and cultural resources (youth). Key research question: “How to successfully bring local youth and other internal resources into use for practical creative innovation?” Goal: to provide strategic solutions through a Creative Hub as a dynamic platform to gather youth talents, support innovative solutions. Approach: Youth engagement/stakeholder analysis is conducted to design the Creative Hub. A pilot project for Tam Ky and Hoi An with local authorities, community leaders, and youth groups for visioning, action plan, and strategy development. Lessons from the creative hub - Ha Noi to be used to identify innovative ideas for mobilizing resources. Methodology: Developing Creative Hub will focus on 1) People: (Youth) as decision-makers. 2) Knowledge relationships 3) Hub identity Activities: - Capacitate to mobilize youth participation for innovations - A pilot project to introduce innovative approaches, - Policy support to promote participative and creative urban solutions Expected results: - Creative hubs are created. - Awareness of socio-cultural assets among local governments /communities is raised for potential partnerships and pathways.
